result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection equipped with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, sidewalks, and pedestrian signals. However, the environment is dominated by asphalt with long crossing distances and lacks physical buffers or traffic calming measures to protect pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across the wide intersection without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk lacks physical separation such as trees or bollards from the moving traffic lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk edges on both sides of the street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while improving the microclimate.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks, but pedestrians face a wide crossing distance across multiple lanes of traffic. hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Parking Near Crosswalk
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the image may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.
